questions.answer: Object.hasOwn(obj, key). The in operator also walks the prototype.

questions.text: What does Object.getPrototypeOf(obj) return?
questions.answer: That object’s [[Prototype]] link. It returns null when there is no prototype.

questions.text: What does the in operator check?
